title: Cloudwatch alarm to Amazon SNS with Amazon Data Firehose to Amazon OpenSearch Service

text: The purpose of this pattern is to deploy the infrastructure necessary to use Kinesis Data Firehose to fanout Cloudwatch Alarms using SNS to the Amazon OpenSearch Service for analytics purposes.
